UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile stored privately per user UID (Google Sign-In only).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified Google account email address (strictly owner-private PII).

displayName.description: User display name from Google profile.

activePersonaId.description: Currently selected AI teacher persona ID (empty string when standard default).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile sync.

AiPersona.title: AiPersona
AiPersona.description: Custom AI teacher personality profile saved per user.

userId.description: Owner user UID matching parent user document.

name.description: Display name of the AI teacher persona.

description.description: Concise personality traits and teaching instructions.

profileImage.description: Optional compressed base64 data URL for the persona profile photo (empty string means clean white profile).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when persona was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest persona edit.

StudyHistoryItem.title: StudyHistoryItem
StudyHistoryItem.description: Saved learning history snapshot (either a generated summary or a generated quiz/practice set) owned by the user.

userId.description: Owner user UID matching parent user document.

type.description: Type of saved study item: summary or quiz.

title.description: Display title of the summary or quiz.

content.description: Full Markdown/text snapshot used for review and AI chat context.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when saved to study history.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A conversation session owned by an authenticated user.

title.description: Short summary title derived from the first user prompt.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the chat session started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message in the session.

ChatMessageDoc.title: ChatMessageDoc
ChatMessageDoc.description: An individual user or assistant chat message inside a chat session.

userId.description: Owner user UID matching parent user document.

content.description: Plain text or Markdown message body.

feedback.description: User rating state for assistant messages.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest update (feedback or retry).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-private user profile, language preference, and active AI persona selection.

/users/{userId}/personas/{personaId}.description: Custom AI teacher personas saved by the user.

/users/{userId}/studyHistory/{itemId}.description: Saved summaries and quizzes in the user's study history.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Chat sessions belonging to a specific user.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Messages belonging to a user's chat session.
